mod.overview: The Need For Speed (v36B) is a high-velocity Tribes combat mod built around drastically faster projectiles, supersonic flyers, boosted jetpacks, and wildly lethal custom weapons. Players spawn directly into Light Armor armed with a Mortar, Disc Launcher, ELF Blaster, Burst gun, Energy Pack, mine, and grenade, letting you jump straight into aggressive flag runs or base-wrecking duels without needing a station first. Compared to base Tribes, everything moves and kills much faster: discs fly at 485 m/s, chainguns shred targets in seconds, any armor can pilot cloaked or nuke-armed flyers, and deployable turrets range from flameguns and NastyBullet chainguns to zero-damage knockback ForceTurrets. Matches run on standard Tribes mission types (CTF, C&H, D&D, and F&R) with infinite team energy, turning every firefight into an explosive, high-speed sandbox.
notes: Armors and Classes: Eight armor types are purchasable at stations (HeavyDestructiveArmor1 is hidden with showInventory = false). Very Light (0.60 HP, speed 19, 380 jetForce, 2 weapons) is the sole carrier of the NukeGun; Light (0.76 HP, speed 21) carries 4 weapons; Light Ballistic (1.32 HP, speed 21) has strong armor resistance (0.3 plasma, 0.5 bullet/explosion/missile/laser) but carries only 1 weapon and no deployable packs; Medium Defensive (1.9 HP, speed 17, 420 jetForce, 5 Repair Kits) and Medium (1.0 HP, speed 16) carry 4 weapons; Heavy (1.82 HP, speed 15, 485 jetForce, 6 weapons) drops Laser Rifle access; Heavy Destructive (1.32 HP, speed 18, 180 energy, 6 weapons) carries the heat-seeking SAM launcher. Note that Light Female (speed 15) and Medium Female (speed 9, SAM-capable) differ from male speeds.

Spawns and Mines: Players spawn in Light Armor carrying a Mortar, ELF Blaster (EnergyRifle), Disc Launcher, Repair Kit, Burst gun (TargetingLaser), Energy Pack, Mine, and Grenade. Thrown mines are tagged with the thrower's team in Mine.cs so teammates do not detonate friendly mines.

Overhauled Weapons: Almost every projectile and fire rate is turbo-charged compared to base Tribes. Discs fly at 485 m/s, Chaingun spins up in 0.01s firing 0.75-damage bullets at 995 m/s, Mortar fires every 0.2s, TargetingLaser is now the Burst gun (990 m/s, 0.95 damage), EnergyRifle is now the ELF Blaster (720 m/s explosive plasma-style bolt), and Laser Rifle has a 0.15 damageConversion multiplier (requiring an Energy Pack). New weapons include the NukeGun (FlierNuke rockets), NastyGun (990 m/s explosive mortar bolts), Flame Thrower (rapid short-range plasma bursts), SAM (heat-seeking GTAM anti-air missile), and RailGun (zero-damage 500-kickback concussion launcher).

Deployables and Base Turrets: Both fixed and remote inventory stations sell all weapons, ammo, and deployable turrets (only DeployableInvPack and DeployableAmmoPack are restricted to fixed stations). Base ELF Turrets fire NastyBullet rounds, and players can deploy Flamegun Turrets (max 8), Chaingun Turrets firing NastyBullets (max 10), Blaster Turrets (max 8), Rocket Turrets (max 8), Remote Turrets (max 15), and ForceTurret Turrets (max 8, zero-damage 500-kickback ForceMissiles).

Vehicles: Any armor can pilot vehicles instead of being restricted to Light Armor, and top speeds are greatly increased: Scout reaches 160 speed with FlierRockets (team max 3), LPC reaches 145 with GrenadeShells (max 2), and HPC reaches 130 with rapid 0.2s MortarShells and 4 passenger seats (max 1). Two new flyers are added: the cloaking Stealth (speed 120, fades out when piloted, hidden from sensors, fires MortarShells, max 1) and the Nuker (speed 90, hidden from sensors, fires FlierNuke warheads every 8.2s, max 1).

Economy, Controls, and Bans: Team energy defaults to Infinite, and no items are banned in $InvList, $RemoteInvList, or $TeamItemMax (aside from HeavyDestructiveArmor1 being hidden and armor-specific $ItemMax limits such as no deployable packs on Light Ballistic and no NukeGun outside Very Light). There are no custom chat #commands; gameplay uses standard Tribes inventory menus, favorites, and Tab menus.

Bots and Maps: Missions use standard Tribes objective types (CTF, C&H, D&D, F&R). The mod bundles SpoonBot (ai.cs and spoonbot.cs with six bot roles and an optional AtomicBomb mode on HPC mortars), but exec("spoonbot.cs") is commented out in NFS.cs by default so auto-spawning bots and the admin Tab menu's Spoonbot controls remain inactive unless the host enables them.
